Culture Amp has been recognized as one of the world’s top private cloud companies by Forbes and most innovative companies by Fast Company. For more information visit cultureamp.com . How you can help make a better world of work We’re looking for a Senior Customer Success Manager to partner with our Named Commercial (Mid‑Market) customers to drive adoption, retention, and expansion outcomes across Culture Amp’s Employee Experience and Performance platform. You’ll thrive here if you’re deeply curious, customer first, and outcomes focused. Responsibilities: Own a book of primarily Named Commercial (Mid‑Market ~400 -1,000 employees) customers and are accountable for exceeding quarterly Gross Revenue Retention (GRR) and growth targets. Build Success Plans, and drive QBRs with HR leaders (CPOs/CHROs), aligning platform use to business and people goals. Enable customers on Culture Amp and the broader people culture domain; deliver strategic guidance that accelerates adoption and value realization for customers tied to their business goals. Coordinate and support the right internal experts at the right moments; ensure seamless handoffs from/to sales customer experience to deliver against customer objectives. Leverage AI-driven tools (e.g., Gemini, Gong, Glean) to synthesize customer insights, refine strategic communication, and proactively identify signals that drive better customer outcomes Document key moments and decisions in our system of record (e.g., Vitally/Salesforce), track value and renewal progress, and communicate clearly and often. Coach customers through challenging conversations, set realistic expectations, and resolve escalations in partnership with internal leaders. Advocate for customers internally by sharing insights and structured feedback to Product and Engineering to improve experience and outcomes. Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives across CS both at the region and global level; sharing playbooks, insights, and scalable practices with the team. After 3 months in this role you’ll: Confidently run customer kick‑offs, QBRs , project meetings, risk mitigation plans; support renewal and expansion motions in collaboration with account managers and renewals to influence GRR and growth goals. Demonstrate working fluency in Culture Amp’s core products (Engagement, Performance, Development AI Coach) and common Mid‑Market use cases.

Lead renewals process discipline and set strategy for renewal negotiations, manage commercial timelines, and hold the team accountable for securing outcomes well ahead of renewal dates; own GRR as a personal accountability. Coach CSMs and Renewals Managers into strategic advisors to develop the team through a consistent operating rhythm of 1:1s, performance coaching, feedback, and career development conversations that build capability and drive accountability. Serve as executive sponsor on high-stakes accounts and act as the senior CX point of contact for complex escalations, expectation resets, and moments where the partnership with the customer is at risk. jobs.title: Senior Customer Success Manager, Commercial
jobs.desc: We’re big believers in the power of IRL, so for most roles we ask Campers to work from their local Culture Amp office an average of 2 days a week to unlock connection, pace and culture together. Join us on our mission to make a better world of work. Culture Amp is the world’s leading employee experience platform, revolutionizing how 25 million employees across more than 6,000 companies create a better world of work. Culture Amp empowers companies of all sizes and industries to transform employee engagement, drive performance management, and develop high-performing teams. Powered by people science and the most comprehensive employee dataset in the world, the most innovative companies including Canva, On, Asana, Dolby, McDonalds and Nasdaq depend on Culture Amp every day. Culture Amp is backed by leading venture capital funds and has offices in the US, UK, Germany and Australia. Culture Amp has been recognized as one of the world’s top private cloud companies by Forbes and most innovative companies by Fast Company. For more information visit cultureamp.com . How you can help make a better world of work We’re looking for a Senior Customer Success Manager to partner with our Named Commercial (Mid‑Market) customers to drive adoption, retention, and expansion outcomes across Culture Amp’s Employee Experience and Performance platform. You’ll be the strategic, post‑sale partner to People Culture leaders, building success plans, leading executive strategy reviews, and translating people science insights into action. This role manages a broad book of business, collaborates very closely within our pod - model that includes Account Management, Renewals, and Account Executives. Other collaborators include People Science, Customer Trainers, Implementation, and Support. This role advocates for the customer voice to influence our roadmap. You’ll thrive here if you’re deeply curious, customer first, and outcomes focused. Responsibilities: Own a book of primarily Named Commercial (Mid‑Market ~400 -1,000 employees) customers and are accountable for exceeding quarterly Gross Revenue Retention (GRR) and growth targets. Build Success Plans, and drive QBRs with HR leaders (CPOs/CHROs), aligning platform use to business and people goals. Proactively drive adoption by monitoring product usage and health to identify risks and expansion opportunities; create and execute mitigation and growth plans in partnership with Account Management and Renewals. Enable customers on Culture Amp and the broader people culture domain; deliver strategic guidance that accelerates adoption and value realization for customers tied to their business goals. Coordinate and support the right internal experts at the right moments; ensure seamless handoffs from/to sales customer experience to deliver against customer objectives. Leverage AI-driven tools (e.g., Gemini, Gong, Glean) to synthesize customer insights, refine strategic communication, and proactively identify signals that drive better customer outcomes Document key moments and decisions in our system of record (e.g., Vitally/Salesforce), track value and renewal progress, and communicate clearly and often. Coach customers through challenging conversations, set realistic expectations, and resolve escalations in partnership with internal leaders. Advocate for customers internally by sharing insights and structured feedback to Product and Engineering to improve experience and outcomes. Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives across CS both at the region and global level; sharing playbooks, insights, and scalable practices with the team. After 3 months in this role you’ll: Confidently run customer kick‑offs, QBRs , project meetings, risk mitigation plans; support renewal and expansion motions in collaboration with account managers and renewals to influence GRR and growth goals. Demonstrate working fluency in Culture Amp’s core products (Engagement, Performance, Development AI Coach) and common Mid‑Market use cases.

jobs.title: Enterprise Account Executive
jobs.desc: We’re big believers in the power of IRL, so for most roles we ask Campers to work from their local Culture Amp office an average of 2 days a week to unlock connection, pace and culture together. Join us on our mission to make a better world of work. Culture Amp is the world’s leading employee experience platform, revolutionizing how 25 million employees across more than 6,000 companies create a better world of work. Culture Amp empowers companies of all sizes and industries to transform employee engagement, drive performance management, and develop high-performing teams. Powered by people science and the most comprehensive employee dataset in the world, the most innovative companies including Canva, On, Asana, Dolby, McDonalds and Nasdaq depend on Culture Amp every day. Culture Amp is backed by leading venture capital funds and has offices in the US, UK, Germany and Australia. Culture Amp has been recognized as one of the world’s top private cloud companies by Forbes and most innovative companies by Fast Company. For more information visit cultureamp.com . How you can help make a better world of work Culture Amp is looking for an exceptional Enterprise Account Executive to join our Enterprise Sales team. In this role, you ll be at the forefront of Culture Amp s growth in the enterprise segment (1,000+ users), hunting new logos and helping the world s most ambitious organisations build a better world of work for their people. You ll bring a consultative, insight-led approach to complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles. You ll partner closely with People Scientists, Customer Success, SDRs, and Marketing to deliver a differentiated experience for enterprise buyers, connecting their people challenges to measurable business outcomes. If you re deeply curious, commercially sharp, and energised by the challenge of winning in a competitive market, you re what we call a #peoplegeek and this role was built for you. You will Drive new logo acquisition across your enterprise territory, owning the full sales cycle from outbound prospecting through to close. Generate a significant portion of your own pipeline through proactive outbounding, using a combination of tools, tactics, and sales methodologies to break into target accounts. Build and manage a robust, accurately forecasted pipeline in Salesforce, maintaining consistent pipeline hygiene and weekly forecast updates. Run tailored, high-impact product demonstrations and business case presentations for People Leaders and executive stakeholders, clearly articulating Culture Amp s competitive differentiators and ROI. Develop specific points of view on your target accounts and build multi-threaded relationships across HR, Finance, and C-suite to drive consensus and accelerate deal velocity. Collaborate cross-functionally with Customer Success, People Science, SDRs, Marketing, Solutions Engineering and RevOps to deliver a seamless, high-quality experience for prospects. Contribute to the broader Enterprise team s craft, sharing learnings, participating in deal clinics, and helping raise the bar on how we sell. You have 6+ years of proven sales experience in a closing role, with a focus on either new business or expansion (or both) A proven track record of consistently meeting or exceeding quota and experience managing complex, multi-stakeholder deals. Strong outbound and self-sourcing capability, with experience building pipeline from scratch rather than relying on inbound and SDR’s channels alone. Deep enterprise sales craft: robust territory and account planning, executive stakeholder engagement, value/ROI-based selling, and the ability to navigate complex commercial negotiations. Experience selling to executive leaders and the ability to connect business initiatives to measurable outcomes. Proficiency in Salesforce and core GTM tools (e.g. Gong, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Outreach); formal sales methodology training (e.g. MEDDPICC, Challenger, Sandler) is a strong plus. Experience in HR tech

Why this role, and why now Our Chief People Officer is moving on after three and a half years. They leave behind a People Experience function that works well: predictable delivery, a capable team, a high bar on senior hiring, and a seat at the table that has been earned and respected. If you want a CPO role where the function is broken and the mandate is to fix it, this isn t it. If you want one where the function is strong and the question is what a leader can do with that platform, keep reading. The uncomfortable and energising fact about working here: our customers are HR leaders. What we do internally isn’t separate from what we sell. Our own practices are watched, asked about, and sometimes bought. It’s an incredible opportunity to innovate and create the future of work. We anticipate there may be interest from current and former customers, and we welcome it! Two things worth being upfront about; applications are visible only to our Talent Acquisition and hiring teams, never to our customer-facing teams. And, being a customer earns you no advantage and no disadvantage. We ll run the same process, set the same bar, and have the same people assessing you. What you ll own The role has several dimensions. They are listed in order of weight, and we mean the order. Run People Experience (PX) well This is a critical part of the job and the thing that has to be true before anything else matters. You ll own a strong and coherent function that delivers its cycles well and on time: performance, engagement, compensation, talent acquisition, capability, compliance across four countries. No surprises to the Exec. No escalations arriving at the CEO s desk that should have been resolved two levels down. The bar we re setting: your deputies own outcomes, not tasks. Executives go to them directly and get good answers. You design the org ahead of the strategy rather than in response to it, so that when the business changes direction the structure is already close to right. Your team respects you, and your senior hires raise the average. You ll be a trusted sounding board to Caroline and the Exec on structure, senior hires, compensation and the calls that don t have clean answers. Be credible in the market and with customers Our customers are your peers. That is a commercial asset, and we want you to use it. You ll speak at our global events and in the market, join customer conversations, and support Sales and Customer Experience in rooms where a practitioner s view might land differently to a vendor s. Over time we d like Sales to be asking for you by name and customers backchannelling you for advice on their own problems. To be clear about the bar: we are not hiring a keynote speaker. You don’t need to be a world-class presenter, and polish is not what we re screening for.
